acceptance_conditions: One outcome identity remains stable across replaceable CLI, API, and workbench realizations.
The initial offer direction contains DomainSpec CLI and read-only Ontology CLI together.
The primary first-offer realization is customer-self-hosted and exposes the DomainSpec CLI plus one equivalent typed automation contract.
An agent request is an input to authorization and never grants repository, filesystem, generator, execution, or deployment authority.
A separately owner-adopted KEP service-exchange capability and admitted ontology extension must precede any KEP API binding.
The current encrypted co-ownership capability, KEP-D1 through KEP-D12, grants no generic service-invocation meaning.
KEP participant identity and message delivery do not authorize a workspace instantiation.
Request, response, failure, and instantiation receipt preserve exact version, participant, correlation, idempotency, payload, omission, and authority-ceiling bindings.
The service derives the authored node meta type and selects only a frozen supported language realization.
Publication is atomic, create-only, path-contained, collision-free, and rejects existing targets.
DomainSpec authoring preserves explicit typed intent and fail-closed project validation.
Instantiation is bounded, deterministic, create-only, and receipt-bearing.
Ontology CLI operations do not mutate, promote, accept, or publish ontology material.
Ontology validation preserves rather than upgrades each native validator verdict.
Validation, generation, identity, entitlement, payment, and receipts do not grant adoption or effect authority.
A current scoped CLI access entitlement is required before customer operation.
Customer source, artifacts, snapshots, and receipts remain under accepted custody, retention, export, and deletion terms.
CLI package identities and versions remain separate from stable business capability identity.
The current Python ontology runtime cannot admit, block, authorize, or route repository work.
CLI inputs and outputs do not authorize deployment, ontology decisions, agent execution, or downstream effects.
Every supported mutating or materializing operation returns a reproducible bounded receipt.
Unknown project, ontology, entitlement, package, baseline, custody, or authority state fails closed.
Sovereign-agent inference, ACP, HTTP, serverless hosting, and model providers remain outside the first offer.
exclusions: making DomainSpec CLI or Ontology CLI names the stable Product Capability identity
claiming the current private CLI or absent self-hosted service binding is released, production-ready, or ready to sell
using the suspended Python ontology runtime to admit, block, authorize, or route repository work
letting an agent invent a meta type or generator, bypass validation, write outside an authorized root, overwrite a target, or deploy generated output
including formalize, formalize-check, arbitrary CLI commands, or future catalog operations in the initial agent contract without separate selection
reinterpreting the admitted encrypted co-ownership KEP capability as a generic service API or modifying KEP-D1 through KEP-D12 through this package
treating KEP identity, request delivery, encryption, acknowledgement, or co-ownership as workspace authorization or instantiation entitlement
treating generated artifacts, validation, receipts, authentication, entitlement, self-hosting, or payment as adoption, security, sovereignty, deployment, or external-effect authority
mutating, promoting, accepting, or publishing customer or CyberAlchemy ontologies through the read-only Ontology CLI
selecting pricing, licensing, packaging, distribution, credential, custody, hosting, or support policy
including CyberAlchemy-hosted inference or a managed sovereign-agent product in the first offer
